name: When should I hire a general contractor versus a handyman for rental property repairs?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a general contractor versus a handyman for rental property repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a general contractor like City Dweller, LLC for larger projects that require coordinating multiple trades, permits, or structural changes, such as major renovations, significant damage repair, or complex system installations. A handyman is suitable for smaller, isolated tasks that don't require specialized licenses or permits, such as fixing a leaky faucet, painting a room, or minor carpentry. General contractors provide oversight and ensure all work adheres to building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for large projects involving multiple trades, permits, or structural changes. Use a handyman for smaller, isolated tasks not requiring specialized licenses.
